purpose: f13 (compressor silencer, Elmer Helmholtz) checks too heavy for the shared dev box: the full-curve public triage panel incl. large-offset (timing calibration on the reference hardware), then the remaining F13-SCIENCE-VALUES-01 checks B1 MMS h 0.025 rung (IDR(s); UMFPACK's workspace fails there), B3 panel coaxials vs mode matching, D1 8 vs 4 mm (large-offset, clearance-boundary), D3 10 vs 5 Hz, and a cold repeat of B2/C/D2/D4/D5 on the pod build. Public panel and controls only; DEVELOPMENT engineering, no adequacy, qualification or LIVE claim.

recommended.machine: runpod-cpu5c-16vcpu (the D3 reference hardware), 16 vCPU, >= 32 GiB

estimated_cpu_hours.basis: f13_proof.estimate (8.3 CPU-s per frequency system at 32,566 nodes, x (nodes/32,566)^1.29, x1.5 safety) from the local cgroup runs; the h 0.025 MMS rung is unmeasured and booked at its 2 h case timeout

recommended.worst_case_basis: 16 vCPU x 7.5 h (setup 0.5 h + step timeouts 3 h + 4 h) x USD 0.035/vCPU-h

steps.name: harness-numpy
steps.judges: nothing: installs python3-numpy and python3-scipy from the pod's own pinned Debian snapshot (sources.list written by the elmer setup) for the MMS quadrature and the mode-matching control; dpkg-query records the versions
argv: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends python3-numpy python3-scipy > {work}/apt.log 2>&1 && dpkg-query -W -f '${{Package}}=${{Version}}\n' python3-numpy python3-scipy | tee {out}/harness-packages.txt

steps.name: f13-triage-panel
steps.judges: bar item 4: measured per-case CPU-s / wall-s / peak memory for every f13 case kind on the reference hardware (D3 counted-plan timeouts >= 2 x p95); the full 201-point curves of all 8 public panel geometries incl. large-offset, both controls, the 5 Hz and 4 mm witnesses, the cold repeat and the separate single-frequency solves. Every case must COMPLETE; curve acceptance is judged by the next step's assembler with the registered bands

steps.name: f13-verification-checks
steps.judges: F13-SCIENCE-VALUES-01, bands fixed before the runs: B1 MMS (4 rungs h 0.2-0.025, monotone, finest-pair order L2 in [2.5, 3.5], H1 in [1.5, 2.5], real and imaginary); B2 straight duct (|TL| <= 0.25 dB, |t - exact| <= 0.03, |r| <= 0.03); B3 coaxial vs mode matching (pointwise <= 0.5 dB at TL <= 20 dB, C4 notch floor 1e-3 W, extrema <= 10 Hz, p10 and mean <= 0.25 dB; mode matching N vs 2N <= 0.05 dB); C1 plane residual <= 0.0018, C2 integral residual <= 0.01, C3 passivity; D1 8 vs 4 mm on nominal/large-offset/clearance-boundary (pointwise <= 0.5 dB, extrema <= 10 Hz, p10 and mean <= 0.25 dB); D2 60 vs 100 mm leads (pointwise <= 0.25 dB, |dt| <= 0.03, p10 and mean <= 0.25 dB); D3 10 vs 5 Hz on clearance-boundary (p10 and mean <= 0.25 dB, minima within 10 Hz); D4 scan vs separate and D5 iterative vs direct (|dTL| <= 0.01 dB, |dt| <= 1e-4). Plus a B3 diagnostic (not a check): the three panel coaxials on the 4 mm mesh vs mode matching. Prints one JSON line per check; FAIL stays a finding (the step passes on exit 0)
